rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-cohort reference data aggregated from five cohorts (HCP Baby, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, HCP Aging, and UK Biobank).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "we assembled high-quality multi-shell diffusion data from five cohorts having closely matched acquisition and processing pipelines, namely Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby [20], HCP Development [21], HCP Young Adult [22], HCP Aging [23] datasets, and UK Biobank [24]."

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP and UK Biobank are used for normative model construction.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "By using high-quality diffusion MRI data from the UK Biobank and the Human Connectome Project, we seek to establish robust models"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP Lifespan cohorts (Baby, Development, Young Adult, Aging) and UK Biobank.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby [20], HCP Development [21], HCP Young Adult [22], HCP Aging [23] datasets, and UK Biobank [24]."
